message:
The zlib is being linked statically but the order matters. Let me put -lz after -lpng and also try using dynamic linking for the system libs.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && g++ -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -std=c++11 -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libass -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/include/harfbuzz -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/include/fribidi -I/usr/include/freetype2 libass_fuzzer.cc /workspace/fuzzer_main.cc -o /workspace/libass_fuzzer /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libass/libass/.libs/libass.a -L/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib -lfontconfig -lfribidi -lfreetype -lharfbuzz -lz -lpng -lexpat -lbrotlidec -lbrotlicommon 2>&1 | tail -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
